checks.name: Physical and spatial checks
checks.detail: Driver/installation-tool envelopes, insertion path, containment, material, strength and printed fit remain unestablished. A nominal screw-head surface screen is reported separately.

access_assessment.name: Screwdriver approach
access_assessment.required: Exact driver shaft/bit/handle envelope, usable reach, approach/rotation path, and any surrounding rack geometry.
access_assessment.limit: Drive size alone does not define the complete tool envelope.

access_assessment.name: Insert installation
access_assessment.required: Exact insert outside diameter and installation-tip envelope/reach, documented installation procedure, material, and installation sequence.
access_assessment.limit: Install tool and hot material clearance are not established by the nominal insert length.

access_assessment.name: Pi insertion/removal path
access_assessment.required: Explicit assembly order and motion path, including mounting fasteners and accessories, followed by swept-volume or equivalent path checks.
access_assessment.limit: A clear final pose does not prove that parts can be inserted or removed.

access_assessment.name: Connector/cable/accessory access
access_assessment.required: Actual cable plug/boot/bend envelopes and intended ports, SD-card service path, heatsink/fan or other accessory geometry.
access_assessment.limit: Bare-board geometry does not supply connected-cable or accessory envelopes.

access_assessment.name: Rack engagement and physical sign-off
access_assessment.required: Mating rack geometry and installation path; actual hardware/material selection; separately approved coupon/prototype and recorded fit/load results.
access_assessment.limit: Digital surface screening is not a strength or physical-fit certification.
